sentences.en: The history books are in the closed reserve section, so you can read them here but not take them out.
sentences.zh: 历史书籍在闭架区，只能在这里阅读不能借出。

sentences.en: Only university professors have access to the closed reserve collection for research purposes.
sentences.zh: 只有大学教授能访问闭架收藏用于研究目的。

sentences.en: Due to their historical significance, these manuscripts are kept in the closed reserve area of the library.
sentences.zh: 由于具有历史意义，这些手稿被保存在图书馆的闭架区。

senses.zh: (图书馆的) 封闭阅读区；封闭阅读书库
